description: ケモ耳大好きᕱ ᕱIllustrator 依頼(3000円〜)▶︎ https://skeb.jp/@motimommm

works.body:
Nice to meet you! My name is Mikecha.

I saw your X (old Twitter) page and thought I would like to contact you to request your help.

I would like to ask you to write my V (please refer to the URL of the document)!
There are no restrictions on clothing, hairstyle, facial expression, composition, etc.
Please write it as you like, Mochi-sama. ☺️

The use of this image will be for icons, thumbnails of videos, and ohaV, etc.
We would appreciate it if you could make it so that the characters are not cut off as much as possible. We would also appreciate transparency of only the characters.

If possible, we would be happy to receive facial expression differences as well. ☺️

Thank you very much for your consideration.

https://x.com/nekooto_mike___?s=21&t=cBL4Qj_TDK0qF8g4cfXXuA

I was attracted by the beautiful and cute design of the picture, so I sent a request.
It is a little bit special, so if you are interested, I would appreciate it very much.
I would like you to draw a character in a balloon for the Mario Party 4 mini-game "Pyon Pyon Balloon.

Reference video
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWQnT5-To7o&pp=ygUe44G044KH44KT44G044KH44KT44OQ44Or44O844Oz
Reference illustration
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/102099398
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/106518620

I would like to have a picture of the four girls of your choice.
The girls you have designed are very cute, so I would like you to draw 4 original girls of your choice.
I would be happy if you could draw a few more girls of your choice if you like.
They should all be the same size.
The base of the drawing should be from a top angle like the illustration below, with the face facing the front of the camera.
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/98696560
The faces should basically be facing frontal.
The face should be facing forward and the expression should be normal, almost like a smile.
The hair should be a little more voluminous to make it look prettier.
The hair on the back can be omitted when combined with the balloon, but we would like to enjoy the front face only as shown in the illustration below, so please draw the hair on the back as well with the difference.
Please send me the following illustration: https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/109302407
I would like to see the head, back hair, hair and other parts, hat and accessories.
I would also like to see a wink or a shy expression on her face.
For reference, the size ratio of the head to the balloons is about 1:3.
The balloons should have a circus-like pattern in each character's image color, just like in the original work.
The balloons should be the same for all the characters and only the color should be changed.
We would appreciate it if you could keep the layers as separate as possible so that we can change the colors.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation.

https://skeb.jp/@ak36epk/works/3

Hello, Mochi🍀.
I would like you to draw my guess, Aoi (Cambu) from Princess Connect.

The composition is up to you.
For your information, this girl is cute when she blushes.
